## Activity

During June 2023, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 94 captures. This report provides a summary of activity, image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The recorded activity represents the total number of captures completed at the site during the reporting period. No new equipment faults were raised by staff during the month.

## Image quality

Of the 94 captures, 4 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.3 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and are included in the reported image quality results. The rate should be monitored as part of routine site oversight, with any recurring issues considered through normal operational review.

## Grading

There were 10 referable results during June 2023. The median grading lag was 1 day. This indicates the midpoint time between capture and completion of grading for the reporting period. Activity, image quality and grading results should continue to be reviewed through the usual site monitoring arrangements. Where appropriate, the site team should use these results to support ongoing service delivery and maintain awareness of image quality and grading timeliness.
